coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Creek Park

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- hand-traced from satellite imagery with the owner's direct, iterative guidance (not a surveyed footprint or GIS file from the project team, and not derived from the PDF-pixel transform, which was unreliable for this specific stretch). Status 'complete' since the landscaping is clearly already built (lawn, paths, trees visible), not a future plan.
notes.digitized_from: Hand-traced from satellite imagery (contextily/Esri World Imagery), guided step-by-step by the owner (who knows this stretch directly) rather than the PDF-pixel transform, which repeatedly mis-located this segment.

record.notes: Covers OCII plan labels P1 and P3 as one combined record -- see digitization_method for why they aren't split.
